title: DisableCallingLocationPostRequest
description: Request body for disabling a calling location.

locationId.description: Unique identifier for the calling location to disable.

locationName.description: Name of the calling location to disable.

forceDelete.description: Force delete is only applicable when calling features like call queues, hunt groups, virtual lines, etc  or a trunk that is not in use exists in the calling location and customer still wants to disable the calling location.
